_notes: Howling Barrows boss + rare loot (2026-10-22). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Hunt-King Valorin.name: Frostbrand of the Hunt-King
Hunt-King Valorin.flavor_text: A hunter's blade rimed over for a thousand winters. It still remembers the sound a quarry makes.

Hunt-King Valorin.name: Rimeplate Hauberk
Hunt-King Valorin.flavor_text: Plate cold enough to stick to bare skin. The Hunt-King wore it to his grave and then some.

Hunt-King Valorin.name: Winterwalker Legguards
Hunt-King Valorin.flavor_text: Leather stiffened with frost, cut for a rider who never once dismounted.

Hunt-King Valorin.name: Horn-Call Longbow
Hunt-King Valorin.flavor_text: A bow of pale heartwood with a horn-mouth carved in the grip. Draw it and something howls back.

Wintermaw the Howling.name: Wintermaw's Fang
Wintermaw the Howling.flavor_text: A fang as long as a dagger on a cord of frayed gut. The cold goes through it.

Wintermaw the Howling.name: Rimefur Cloak
Wintermaw the Howling.flavor_text: Cut from a hound that should not have been able to die, and was.

Wintermaw the Howling.name: Houndkeeper's Gauntlets
Wintermaw the Howling.flavor_text: Chained gauntlets, gnawed through at the knuckle. Whoever wore them lost the argument.
